versions.changelog:
- Initial release of "恐怖惊魂夜" (Horror Night), an interactive horror script-kill adventure set in a snowed-in mountain hotel.
- Features multi-ending story progression, clue investigation, character interaction, and branching narrative structure.
- Includes detailed chapter/scene breakdown (7 main chapters, 7 possible endings).
- Implements a layered clue system requiring active player investigation and open-ended choices.
- Game system files cover: state management, clue tracking, character networks.
- Designed for immersive, suspenseful gameplay with multiple roles and gradual storytelling.
